steps.title: The axes
steps.say: Price is on the vertical axis and quantity on the horizontal axis.

steps.title: Demand curve
steps.say: Demand slopes down: the lower the price, the more people want to buy.

steps.title: Supply curve
steps.say: Supply slopes up: the higher the price, the more sellers want to sell.

steps.title: Starting equilibrium
steps.say: The curves cross at the equilibrium, price 5 and quantity 5, where buyers and sellers agree.

steps.title: Demand rises
steps.say: When demand rises, the demand curve moves right. At the old price buyers want more than sellers offer, so the price is pushed up.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.say: Both price and quantity end up higher. Try dragging the curves to see how the equilibrium moves.
